process.title: How It Works
process.subtitle: Simple and transparent, from 3D model to physical product.
process.step1Desc: Upload your STL, 3MF, or CAD file and pick your preferred material and color.
process.step2Desc: Get clear, immediate pricing based on dimensions, material choice, and infill settings.
process.step3Desc: We print your parts with care on calibrated printers for a clean, accurate result.
process.step4Desc: Carefully packaged and delivered within 2 to 5 business days via PostNL with tracking.
process.guaranteeText: Every print is inspected for surface quality and fit before dispatch, ready for use right out of the box.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Clear answers regarding single orders, student projects, materials, and invoicing.
faq.q1: Can I order a single piece without a minimum order quantity?
faq.a1: Yes, absolutely! We have no minimum order size. Single-item prints are always welcome.
faq.q2: Can students and educational institutions order models?
faq.a2: Yes! We regularly help students and educators print scale models, prototypes, and graduation projects with fast turnaround.
faq.q3: Can businesses order with an official VAT invoice?
faq.a3: Yes, business customers receive a clear, itemized VAT invoice for easy accounting.
faq.q4: What is the typical turnaround and delivery time?
faq.a4: Most orders are printed and dispatched within 2 to 5 business days using tracked PostNL delivery across the Netherlands.
